<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

These delays disrupt real-time claim processing and cause financial friction for downstream partners.\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Orrinbury Fleet Insurance reports delays with webhook retries on its supplier payments module, which affects how it processes claims and updates policyholders in real time [i:23d386fc82d6c342].\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance says the issue has been holding up payments, and suppliers are starting to ask questions [i:2c5599e0c4552f3a].\n- Holloway Reach Underwriting says the delays are not just inconvenient but are holding up payments and supplier invoices too [i:45301fb117b39eed].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- Across 3 accounts, there are 3 mentions of this problem, arriving via 2 routes: 2 mentions from sales and 1 from support [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].\n- The affected accounts represent 1690000.0 GBP in total ARR: Orrinbury Fleet Insurance at 120000.0 GBP, Callowfield Auto Assurance at 1250000.0 GBP, and Holloway Reach Underwriting at 320000.0 GBP [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].\n- Orrinbury Fleet Insurance raised the webhook retry delays on 2026-10-22, across 3 accounts [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].\n- The affected accounts carry 1690000.0 GBP in total ARR, including Callowfield Auto Assurance at 1250000.0 GBP direction: delayed payments and status updates are disrupting real-time claim processing and creating financial friction for downstream partners response.content: {"critique": "I checked the Problem statement against the three cited insights. The claim that delays stem from 'slow webhook retries and approval processes' is only partially supported: webhook retry delays appear only in Orrinbury's quote, and 'approval processes' is not mentioned in any cited insight, making it an uncited claim. The account-level claims, ARR figures (120000 + 1250000 + 320000 = 1690000 GBP), mention counts (3 mentions, 2 sales / 1 support), dates, and renewal dates all match the fact sheet and cited insights, and no paraphrases are placed in quotation marks. However, the unsupported 'approval processes' claim in the opening paragraph fails faithfulness.", "verdict": "fail"}
